mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_allocation (node_id, task_type, task_id, tenant_id, gpu_count, cpu, memory_bytes, gpu_devices, status) VALUES (#{nodeId}, #{taskType}, #{taskId}, #{tenantId}, #{gpuCount}, #{cpu}, #{memoryBytes}, #{gpuDevices}::jsonbNULL, COALESCE(#{status}, 'held'))
mapper.select: SELECT #{nodeId} AS node_id, COALESCE(SUM(gpu_count), 0) AS sum_gpu, COALESCE(SUM(cpu), 0) AS sum_cpu, COALESCE(SUM(memory_bytes), 0) AS sum_memory, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM resource_allocation WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} AND status = 'held'
SELECT id, node_id, task_type, task_id, tenant_id, gpu_count, cpu, memory_bytes, gpu_devices, status, acquired_at, released_at FROM resource_allocation WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} AND status = 'held'

SELECT id, node_id, task_type, task_id, tenant_id, gpu_count, cpu, memory_bytes, gpu_devices, status, acquired_at, released_at FROM resource_allocation WHERE task_type = #{taskType} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'held' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE resource_allocation SET status = 'released', released_at = NOW() WHERE task_type = #{taskType} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'held'
UPDATE resource_allocation SET status = 'released', released_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'held'
UPDATE resource_allocation SET status = 'released', released_at = NOW() WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} AND status = 'held'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource_allocation WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} AND status = 'held'
